poteau.description: Red, white and navy, barber-pole stripes and a price list in columns, 1950s style.

brique.description: Brick, steel and bulb light: a warehouse barbershop with tall, tight lettering.

club.description: Bottle green, brass and Caslon: the hushed lounge of a gentlemen’s club.

marina.description: Whitewash, sea blue and sunshine: the harbour barber, open to the light.

fade.description: Concrete, black and safety orange, giant capitals for the fade studio.

ottoman.description: Copper, teal and engraved capitals: the old-school shave of an Istanbul barber.

nord.description: Stone grey, slate and a Nordic grotesque: men’s grooming without a word too many.

flash.description: Ink black, red and mustard, the blackletter of tattoo flash sheets.

enseigne.description: Green, red and tile white, the bilingual hand-painted sign of the corner men’s hairdresser.

ocre.description: Terracotta, ochre and linen, a warm studio for curls and natural hair.

wax.description: Vermilion, yellow and green, the bold graphic blocks of Lagos and Abidjan wax prints.

harlem.description: Midnight plum, gold and Art Deco letters: the elegance of Harlem salons in the jazz age.

labo.description: White, teal and peach, clean as a lab: diagnosis and care for curls.

tresses.description: Plum, saffron and a woven motif, the atelier where every braid is a drawing.

sanctuaire.description: Moss, clay and raw paper, a calm place to start and maintain your locs.

zenith.description: Deep teal, gold and bright orange: an Afrofuturist salon of bold, full shapes.

sahel.description: Hand-dyed indigo and warm sand, the restraint of the Sahel’s wide open spaces.

caraibes.description: Turquoise, coral and mango, a joyful salon that smells of island summer.

onyx.description: Matte black and a thread of gold, spaced capitals and almost nothing else.

seoul.description: Milky pink, lavender and rounded corners: a soft Seoul-style nail studio where photos are the shop window.

francaise.description: Nude, white and a fine Bodoni: the elegance of a French manicure, with prices in columns like a menu.

chrome.description: Steel grey and graphite, black-and-white photos in a metal frame, for chrome nail art.

regard.description: Black and powder pink, a precise line: the lash and brow bar, with the technician in the spotlight.

cerise.description: Cherry red on cream, a retro menu card for classic manicures and flawless polish.

starlette.description: Candy pink, baby blue and puffy letters: Y2K nail art with the studio name scrolling by.

verveine.description: Leaf green, linen and a botanical border: the nail spa for natural care and rested hands.

cabine.description: Clinical white, steel blue and monospaced figures: a clean page with full-screen booking.

miami.description: Turquoise, peach and sunset stripes, with round pop lettering for a sunny nail studio.

memphis.description: Flat cobalt, yellow and turquoise, sharp corners and black lettering: a graphic salon in the Memphis spirit.

riso.description: Blue and fluorescent pink on paper, two-tone photos: a salon that looks like a printed zine.

menthe.description: Raspberry pink and mint green, round and playful shapes for a young, smiling salon.

bulle.description: Red, yellow and halftone dots, punchy comic-book lettering for a salon full of energy.

arcade.description: Teal, magenta and round letters: the 90s shopping-mall salon, with its name set vertically.

marelle.description: Sky blue, soft yellow and round shapes: a family salon where kids and grown-ups feel welcome.

campus.description: Black, white and lime green, prices readable at a glance and booking right at the top of the page.

fresque.description: Concrete, signal yellow and giant condensed letters: the neighbourhood salon painted like a street-art wall.

citronnade.description: Mediterranean blue and lemon yellow, the photo framed like a summer market poster.

apothicaire.description: Amber glass, paper and Caslon capitals: a treatment menu set like the label on a bottle.

riad.description: Tadelakt, terracotta and zellige green: the photo framed like a riad courtyard.

marbre.description: Veined marble, copper and Roman capitals: the hot room of a Turkish bath, in light tones.

onsen.description: Washi paper, ink and cedar: the name set vertically, with the calm of a Japanese bath.

sauna.description: Snow light, lake slate and pale wood: the clarity of a Nordic sauna.

dune.description: Sand, red rock and evening sky: a Saharan spa in large format, warm and unhurried.

thermes.description: White and thermal-water blue: treatments bookable from the first screen, like the front desk of a spa resort.

veillee.description: Candlelight on a night-brown ground: an intimate evening spa where the venue’s name holds the stage.

derma.description: Clinical white, a single red and a precise grid: the rigour of a dermatology practice.

rosee.description: Peony pink, mist blue and soft shapes: the glass skin of Korean rituals.

officine.description: Apothecary green, crisp white and shop-sign lettering: address and treatments at hand, as in a pharmacy.

champagne.description: Lacquer black and champagne, a large Didone: the high-end skincare boutique as a magazine page.

protocole.description: Lab white and chartreuse green: treatments laid out like protocols, prices and durations aligned.

quartz.description: Rose quartz and powdery light under a soft arch, for a delicate beauty institute.

kraft.description: Kraft paper, leaf green and label lettering: handmade organic cosmetics, poster style.

perle.description: Deep plum and pearl white, the name set large as on a jewel case: high-end anti-ageing care.

lagune.description: Deep teal and pale mint, the centre’s name scrolling by: the med-spa of today.

studio.description: Bright and warm, in Saloneo orange, for an all-round salon that leads straight to booking.

atelier.description: Editorial feel: the salon name in large type like a poster, services laid out like a menu.

hammam.description: Deep green, sand and copper with a Moorish arch, for hammams and spas.

barber.description: Charcoal, brass and condensed lettering: the chalkboard of a neighborhood barber.

onglerie.description: Fuchsia and lilac, with color dots like polish bottles, for nail studios.

mariee.description: Ivory, champagne and powder pink, with space and light for bridal and makeup.

institut.description: Clean and calming, sage green and precise typography for a beauty institute.

karakou.description: Burgundy velvet and gold thread, the photo in a gilded frame: the elegance of the karakou and the chedda for the traditional bride.

blanc.description: White and pearl grey, a monogram and plenty of air: the modern, pared-back bride.

roseraie.description: Old rose and sage green with a botanical border: the romantic garden wedding.

henne.description: Henna brown and saffron, a fine scatter of dots like a hand-drawn pattern, for the henna night.

gala.description: Lacquered black and ivory, cinematic framing and high-contrast capitals: the gala evening.

boheme.description: Sand, terracotta and linen, soft shapes and warm photos for the boho beach wedding.

sultane.description: Emerald, gold and Iznik red with a frieze of arches: the royal bride, Ottoman-inspired.

taqendurt.description: Yellow, red and green on white, with trims like those of the Kabyle dress, for weddings in Kabylie.

age-dor.description: Ivory, black and champagne, vertical Art Deco lettering: the glamour of the great film stars.

casbah.description: Whitewash and door blue, an arch and a frieze of arcades: the Casbah of Algiers, kept simple.

kabylie.description: Charcoal, silver and coral, with sharp angles like the Berber jewellery of Aït Yenni.

tlemcen.description: Ochre, faience green and zellige: the Andalusian elegance of Tlemcen for a salon of tradition.

constantine.description: Grey stone and copper, with lines drawn taut like the cables of Constantine’s suspension bridges.

tassili.description: Golden sand and the red of rock paintings, a grain of desert: the Sahara of the Tassili.

oran.description: Sea blue and sun yellow, booking right from the start: Oran, modern and Mediterranean.

mzab.description: Sky blue, peach and mint, a mosaic of photos: the pastel houses of the M’zab valley.

timgad.description: Pale stone and laurel green, engraved Roman capitals: the ancient rigour of Timgad.

alger-blanche.description: Cream façades and wrought iron, the photo framed like a window: Algiers the White and its grand boulevards.

medina.description: Indigo, saffron and zellige: a tribute to the Casbah for a salon rooted in its heritage.

noir.description: Deep black and gold, with the team in the spotlight: the high-end salon.

nordique.description: Light oak, pine green and plenty of air: a calm, precise Scandinavian concept salon.

encre.description: Clean white, ink black and a vermilion seal: the minimal Tokyo-style cutting studio.

pigment.description: Teal, coral and candy pink: an East London colour bar where the name scrolls large.

terrazzo.description: Walnut, terrazzo and warm light: the Milanese salon, photos framed like an architecture review.

balayage.description: Bleached sand, clay and sea foam: the Californian balayage studio, shot wide like a summer film.

galerie.description: White walls and a single ultramarine blue: the salon as a gallery, services hung in a grid.

beton.description: Polished concrete, black capitals and an architect’s grid: the raw loft where you book on arrival.

vendome.description: Ivory and black, fine jeweller’s lettering: the Parisian hair maison, understated and sovereign.

deco.description: Onyx and gold, the photo set in a gilded frame: the Art Deco salon, its prices engraved in columns.

haussmann.description: Cream, mouldings and zinc grey: the grand Haussmann apartment turned salon, beneath its arched windows.

velours.description: Burgundy velvet and champagne nude: Italian couture hairdressing, laid out like a fashion magazine.

greige.description: Greige, stone and soft shapes: contemporary luxury in a single shade, without a word too many.

salon-prive.description: Bottle green and brass, the address given upfront: the private salon you visit by appointment.

couverture.description: Black-on-white Didone and lipstick red: the salon on a magazine cover, its name as a giant headline.

riviera.description: Champagne, navy blue and cabana stripes: the Riviera salon, elegant and sun-drenched.

laque.description: Washi paper, urushi lacquer and silence: the Japanese luxury of restraint, a short, chosen menu.

epure.description: Black and white, nothing extra: the most understated layout in the collection.

soleil.description: Coral and sunny yellow, for a friendly, welcoming, cheerful family salon.

botanique.description: Linen, olive and clay, in a magazine-style layout for natural care.
